name: Event Calendar
description: A shared calendar of upcoming events that can be browsed by day, week or month
backend_requirements: Access control: anyone may read events; require auth for creating, updating and deleting events; admin endpoints are restricted to the admin account
Events: any signed-in user may create, update and delete any event; created_by records the creator's username; DELETE /api/events/:id removes the event permanently

Event validation: title is a required non-empty string of at most 200 characters; start_time is a required ISO 8601 date-time; end_time, when given, is an ISO 8601 date-time not before start_time (equal is allowed); description is at most 2000 and location at most 200 characters
Date-times without a UTC offset are taken as UTC, and responses give every date-time in UTC with a trailing Z

GET /api/events returns active events sorted by start_time ascending; ?start_date= and ?end_date= (YYYY-MM-DD, both inclusive, either may be omitted) keep events whose start_time falls on a UTC date in that range, a start_date after end_date answers 400, and total counts every matching event
Deactivated events (is_active false) are left out of GET /api/events and answer 404 on the public event endpoints; the admin overview still lists them
Errors answer with a JSON object {"detail": "<message>"}: 400 for invalid input, 401 without a valid token, 403 for a non-admin on admin endpoints, 404 for unknown ids
frontend_requirements: Everyone sees the event list and event details read-only; signed-in users also get the add, edit and delete controls, and visitors see a 'Sign in to add events' prompt in their place
Sign-in and registration forms that call /api/auth/login and /api/auth/register; keep the token for later requests, show the signed-in username and offer sign-out
Event list grouped by date with a heading per day, each event showing its time range, title and location, shown in the viewer's local time zone
Quick filters Today, This Week, This Month and All that request the matching ?start_date=&end_date= range
Selecting an event opens its details (title, time range, location, description, creator) in a dialog
Add and edit forms with a date and time picker for start and an optional end, title, location and description; they show the API's validation messages, and delete asks for confirmation first
admin_requirements: Admin overview: every event, active or not, with total, active and inactive counts
Toggle an event's active status from the overview
